in_marathi.name: Eswaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eswaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eswaran is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Eshwara', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. In Hindu mythology, Eshwara is a form of Shiva, the God of destruction and regeneration. This name is often given to a child born on a Tuesday, as Tuesday is considered a lucky day for Shiva devotees.
